description: This file contains the implementation of a PSR-7 Response class, which provides an HTTP response message following the PSR-7 standard, including status code, headers, reason phrase, and body handling.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 ResponseInterface, representing an HTTP response message with status, headers, and body.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Response object with optional status, headers, body, protocol version, and reason phrase.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase.
